frequency_question: What proportion of contested health or major regulatory agency nominations successfully secure a floor confirmation vote and pass within a 60-day window?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet-level and major statutory agency head nominations (e.g., FDA, HHS, CDC, EPA) that faced significant political opposition or delay, excluding routine uncontested military or judicial confirmations.
